description: Reports whether Shodan's pre-collected passive scan data shows SNMP (UDP port 161) seen open on an IPv4 address. Passive and possibly old; no community string is tried, so default or public community access is not tested. Related tools on this server, for a different need: security_rdp_exposure_check when you need to check Shodan's passive scan records for TCP port 3389; security_smb_exposure_test when you need to check Shodan's passive scan records for TCP port 445. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_snmp_exposure
title: Reports whether Shodan's pre-collected passive scan data
